branch_presence.note: fraction of IRs containing >=1 branch node (op==branch, any status); the predicate/effects payload may sit on a non-branch carrier (see corpus.carrier_mix)

gate_rule.agreement_rate: all-rows (missing counts as disagreement; UNMEASURABLE/NA excluded from denominators)

veto_rule: PASS -> HARD VETO; FAIL & present_only>=0.90 -> positive-only veto / soft evidence (unknown-if-absent); FAIL & present_only<0.90 -> excluded
